The `/code-review:code-review` command reviews a pull request, but there's nothing to review here:

- `gh pr list --state all` returns an empty list — [losskot/local-whisper](https://github.com/losskot/local-whisper) has no pull requests, open or closed.
- The only branch is `main` (locally and on the remote), with no PR associated with it.

Since the eligibility check has nothing to run against, I stopped rather than proceeding through the review pipeline.

To get a review, you can either:
1. Give me a PR number/URL from a different repo (`/code-review:code-review 123`).
2. Push a branch and open a PR here first, then re-run the command.
3. If you want the *uncommitted* changes on `main` reviewed instead, use the `/code-review` skill — it reviews the current diff without needing a PR. Note your working tree currently only has `.specstory/` session-data JSON modifications, which are tool artifacts rather than source changes, so there'd be little to review there either.
